sentences.text: The respondent no. 2 due to matrimonial differences
, got registered FIR bearing no. 0846/2021 under sections 498A/406/34 IPC at P.S. Dabri.

After conclusion of investigation, the charge-sheet was filed wherein the petitioner was implicated, trial of which is stated to be pending in the court of Ms. Vaishali Singh, MM (Mahila Court), Dwarka Courts, Delhi/Successor Court.
The petitioner and the respondent no. 2 are identified by the Investigating Officer ASI Rajender, P.S. Dabri.

6. The petitioner and the respondent no. 2 due to intervention of elderly members of the family have settled their disputes vide Settlement Deed/Memo of Understanding stated to be executed on 07.12.2023 whereby the respondent no. 2 has agreed not to pursue with the judicial proceedings arising out of the present FIR and it is stated that the petitioner and the respondent no. 2 are living together happily at their matrimonial home since their marriage and never separated.

7. The counsel for the petitioner stated that since the inception of marriage, the petitioner and the respondent no. 2 stated that are living together happily with mutual love, affection and understanding and never separated as such, the present petition be allowed and FIR bearing no.
0846/2021 be quashed along with consequential judicial proceedings.

8. The respondent no. 2 stated that she has settled with the petitioner out of her own free will and without any force, fear or coercion and is living happily with the petitioner in the matrimonial home as such, she does not have any objection if the present petition is allowed and FIR bearing no.
0846/2021 is quashed along with consequential judicial proceedings.
9. The Additional Public Prosecutor for the State/respondent no. 1 stated This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 15/12/2023 at 23:30:28 that the petitioner and the respondent no. 2 have settled their disputes vide Settlement Deed/Memo of Understanding stated to be executed on 07.12.2023 and out of the settlement, they are living together happily with mutual love, affection and understanding as such, he does not have any objection if the present petition is allowed and FIR bearing no. 0846/2021 is quashed along with consequential judicial proceedings.

10. The petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 got married on 28.04.2018 and they have settled their disputes vide Settlement Deed/Memo of Understanding stated to be executed on 07.12.2023 and out of the settlement, they are living together since inception of their marriage with mutual love,
affection and understanding.
No useful purpose shall be served if the proceedings arising out of the present FIR are allowed to be continued and it would be an exercise in futility.

After considering all facts, the present petition is allowed and FIR bearing no. 0846/2021 dated 05.10.2021 registered under sections 498A/406/34 IPC at P.S. Dabri along with consequential proceedings including judicial proceedings stated to be pending in the court of Ms. Vaishali Singh, MM (Mahila Court),
Dwarka Courts, Delhi/Successor Court is quashed.
11. The present petition stands disposed of.
